critique.evidence: The oversized “One residual evidence gap.” headline and singular numbered risk card create a clear, confident editorial moment across desktop, tablet, and mobile. However, the dark grid, cyan/red accents, monospaced labels, outlined pills, and bordered dashboard card are familiar cyber-security UI conventions; there is no distinctive visualization or interaction shown that makes the unknowns concept uniquely recognizable or demo-defining.
critique.fix: Turn the residual gap into a signature visual artifact—for example, a prominent evidence-boundary map or animated gap diagram connecting the 69.6% recall, missing evidence, and next control—then make that motif drive the card and CTA. Reduce generic terminal-style decoration so the unique unknowns visualization becomes the screen’s memorable centerpiece.
